positions.description:
• Lead technical direction for a team of 7–8 engineers; drive architectural reviews and maintain consistency across micro-services and internal tooling.
  • Formalized infrastructure cost optimization: S3 lifecycle and EC2 cleanup reduced storage costs by ~90%.
  • Mentor engineers on system design, production debugging, and scalability tradeoffs.

• Led migration of core CKYC platform from single-tenant to multi-tenant SaaS and decoupled Celery workers for async workloads; system processes 5,000+ compute-intensive tasks daily.
  • Designed and built Bolt, an internal Python framework standardizing AWS, DB, Rule Engine and logging integrations; reduced new-service setup time from ~3 days to ~4 hours for a 15+ engineering team.
  • Architected and delivered an on-premise Video KYC system using LiveKit (WebRTC) for real-time multi-party sessions, meeting strict banking data-sovereignty and on-prem compliance requirements.
  • Owned RBL Bank backend migration from Python 2.7 to 3.8 and technical issues, reducing production support tickets by ~80%.
  • Led Dockerization of backend services and introduced CI/CD automation via bash-based pipelines, reducing manual deployment effort and configuration drift across enterprise client environments.
  • Built configuration-driven KYC form systems that decoupled business logic from code, enabling non-engineering teams to launch new flows without backend changes.

• Led frontend development for lending platforms (OneApp, Upsell) in React.js; increased unit test coverage to 100%, improving regression stability during frequent product iterations.
  • Built a scalable, JSON-config-driven form engine for KwikID so edge cases were handled through configuration instead of code changes.
  • Refactored legacy Angular apps into a modular, component-based structure and took on full-stack work—backend APIs and fixes in Python and SQL.
• Delivered three integrated web applications (customer, admin, delivery) with Node.js and Angular; integrated real-time messaging (PubNub), payments (Stripe), and document storage (MongoDB Atlas).
